hook: "11 winning AI creative formats I abused to print $12M+ on Meta ads (and the psychology behind why each one prints)"
body: A catalog of 11 formats: native UGC (3-4x CTR vs polished), founder talking head (parasocial familiarity), claymation (2-3x thumb-stop), Pixar-style 3D (halo effect → higher perceived value), musical/jingle (96% higher recall), screen-recording walkthrough (proof-by-demonstration), before/after (visual comparison), testimonial compilation (smallest-first escalation), cinematic demo (Apple-keynote halo), mini-documentary (narrative transportation drops resistance 50%+), meme/native (lowest CPMs).
cta: DM me "META" if you want us to deploy this creative system for your specific offer.
idea: Authority thread packaging 11 AI creative formats with the psychology behind each, as a lead magnet for the author's agency.
sequencing: Hook: $12M+ claim + "psychology behind why each one prints" promise.
Context beat: 2026 Meta = creative is the only variable; format matters more than copy.

Formats 1-11, each with a named psychological mechanism (categorization, parasocial familiarity, novelty, halo effect, jingle recall, proof-by-demonstration, visual comparison, compounding social proof, premium halo, narrative transportation, trojan-horse native).
Production cheat code: 3 tools (Seedance 2.0 via Higgsfield MCP, ChatGPT Images 2.0, Opus 5) → near-zero cost, 50-100+ variations/month.
Operating doctrine: run 3-4 formats simultaneously, kill losers in 72h, scale winners with 80% budget.
CTA: DM "META" for the creative system on your offer.
formatting: Long-form text post (numbered list, ~500 words); no media in the pulled copy. Written as an agency pitch thread aimed at marketers.
why_it_works: Value density + specificity ($12M, 3-4x CTR, 96% recall) earns the bookmark, and the taxonomy gives readers a mental filing system that makes the author the authority on AI creative.
what_to_steal: The mechanism-per-format framing: attach a named psychological principle to each format so the team knows WHEN to use it, and the "run 3-4 formats, kill losers in 72h" operating doctrine — directly portable to a jewelry creative-testing matrix.

hook: "INSANE fucking growth. Storytelling Drama ads is the main format. Here's 199 of these bangers from Pocket FM."
body: Points to 199 Pocket FM storytelling drama ads as the model set. The post reveals the format's signature traits: serialized cliffhanger storytelling borrowed from audio-drama apps, long-running episodes, and direct adaptability to ecom products.
cta: Link to the gethookd board of 199 Pocket FM storytelling drama ads.
idea: Pocket FM's serial-episode drama ads are the reference implementation of fiction-serial-native creative; collect and model them.
sequencing: Hook: "INSANE fucking growth" + authority claim (storytelling drama = the main format).
Proof anchor: 199 examples from one brand (Pocket FM).
Directive: "Model and adapt for your Ecom products."
formatting: Two-line hype post + link-out to an external swipe board (app.gethookd.ai). No breakdown of a single ad; the value is the collection.
why_it_works: Curation as content: one mega-number (199) plus a single exemplar brand does the convincing; the reader borrows the strategist's homework instead of doing it.
what_to_steal: The directive itself: mine Pocket FM's 199-ad set for cliffhanger structures ("tune in tomorrow") and port episode logic to a jewelry storyline (e.g., a serial where each episode ends on a jewelry reveal).
